name: changelui
description: ChangelUI: small, import-friendly React components and effects (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion)
author: Pulkit Srivastava <changelui.support@gmail.com> (https://changelui.com)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsup && node scripts/fix-cjs-directive.ts && node scripts/fix-cjs-sourcemaps.ts && npm run build:css
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run check:dist
